integrity: The proof uses explicit symbolic transfer and analytic inequalities; finite arithmetic independently confirms small cases but is not extrapolated as proof.
limitations: Eventual rather than effective sharp thresholds; original preprint 2021-12-27, the conjecture text verified in the 2022-12-20 revision. No five-term result, no exact spectral-growth constant, no independent mathematical audit.
title: Eventual strict growth of sixfold evil and odious representation counts
